content.title: Migration recommendation
content.body:
## Recommendation: lift-and-shift SALES schema to the lakehouse

The legacy `SALES` schema on the on-prem **Oracle 19c** instance (`orcl-sales-prod`) backs the retired Order Management app. Data is read-only since the app was decommissioned in Q1. Recommend a raw lift-and-shift of the three core tables into **Databricks** (Unity Catalog `sales_raw`), full-load, weekly refresh not required (one-time). `ORDERS` is high-volume (~180M rows); `ORDER_LINES` ~640M; `CUSTOMERS` ~2.1M. Primary key on `ORDERS.ORDER_ID`. `ORDERS.UPDATED_AT` could serve as an incremental cursor if an ongoing sync is later needed.
